$comment: Written by npm run schemas from core/schema. Change the definition there, not this file.
title: A Claude desktop session file
description: Claude desktop's claude-code-sessions/<account>/<organization>/local_*.json, which XenoNet reads for what the Agent SDK doesn't say (title, starred, archived, worktree, lineage) and for the account a session ran as. The files carry no version, so the newest schema reads them.

cliSessionId.description: Claude Code's session id, which the Agent SDK lists the session by; a record without one isn't merged

sessionId.description: Claude desktop's own id for it (local_…)

originCwd.description: The folder it started in; a worktree session's repo

sessionId.description: The local_… id of the session that started it
